Should you push through pain while writing UPSC answers? Dr. Rachita Luthra explains why discomfort shouldn’t be ignored and why addressing it matters before continuing your task.

Dr. Rachita Luthra joins LevelUp IAS to answer common questions about posture, long sitting hours and discomfort during UPSC preparation.

Join our free offline workshop, POSTURE, PAIN & MOVEMENT DURING UPSC PREPARATION, to learn practical ways to care for your body while studying.

📍 LevelUp IAS, New Delhi
